meta.title: D Bhargava Rama Sarma - AI/ML Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of D Bhargava Rama Sarma - AI/ML engineer building document intelligence, distributed systems, and applied ML.

hero.description: I build document intelligence pipelines, fault-tolerant systems, and applied ML tools - from OCR that reads scanned invoices to a RAFT consensus cluster running a shared drawing canvas.

bullets: Built an internal OCR document-understanding pipeline in a team of two - CNN layout detection, transformer text recognition, attention-based field extraction - reaching 88% extraction accuracy on scanned documents.
Designed the preprocessing layer end-to-end: denoising, deskewing, adaptive thresholding across ingestion, a key contributor to accuracy on low-quality scans.

Trained XGBoost and k-NN models on librosa audio features and CNN image features to detect Parkinson's disease from voice, spiral, and wave-drawing inputs - 85% classification accuracy across three modalities.
Built a Flask app for real-time sample upload and AI symptom analysis, unifying all three input modes behind one interface.

projects.title: Parkinson's Disease Detector
projects.description: An ML pipeline that flags Parkinson's disease markers from voice and drawing samples, the same multimodal approach later extended during the CHEL research internship.

projects.title: Real-Time Collaborative Drawing Board
projects.description: A RAFT-inspired consensus algorithm across a 3-node replica cluster - automatic leader election, majority log replication, follower recovery after restart - driving a live multi-user canvas broadcast over WebSocket.

projects.title: Sports Celebrity Image Classification
projects.description: Image classifier using wavelet-transform feature extraction reaching 95% accuracy, served through a Flask + OpenCV backend with a Dropzone.js upload frontend.

projects.title: Election Management System
projects.description: A system for managing elections end-to-end - candidate and voter registration, ballot handling, and result tabulation - built as a structured Flask application.

projects.title: Traffic Sign Detection Robot
projects.description: A ROS 2 Jazzy simulation of an autonomous differential-drive robot that detects traffic signs with a GTSRB-trained CNN and reacts in real time - slowing, stopping, or speeding up - across 7 coordinated nodes with RViz2 visualization and no external simulator.

projects.title: Real Estate Price Prediction
projects.description: A price estimator for Bengaluru housing trained on historical sale data, predicting value from square footage, BHK, and bathroom count through a Flask backend with a web client frontend.

projects.title: Global Conflict & Event Tracker
projects.description: A real-time intelligence dashboard using Perplexity AI for NLP event extraction and severity classification on an hourly ingestion pipeline, mapped live with clustering markers on React-Leaflet.
